analog_now.method: feature vector per bar (1/3/5/10/20-bar returns, RSI-14, distance to SMA-20, 10-bar volatility), nearest neighbours by scaled Euclidean distance; analog outcomes must end before the origin bar (no lookahead)
analog_now.warning: A histogram of what followed similar setups in THIS sample — not a price forecast, not a probability about the future, and worthless without the out-of-sample evaluation next to it.

candle_analog_now.method: candle vector per completed bar (gap, range, signed body and 3-bar body, close location, wick balance, range expansion, relative volume); nearest neighbours by scaled Euclidean distance; outcomes must end before origin
candle_analog_now.warning: A second conditional histogram of THIS sample, not another oracle. Judge it only by the candle rows in the hidden-future ensemble evaluation.

indicator_data.note: On close-only bars, range-based indicators collapse to functions of the close path; they do not invent highs, lows or candle anatomy.

indicator_analog_now.method: 15 origin-time indicator/regime features per completed bar (RSI level/slope, ATR-normalized MACD, Bollinger %B/bandwidth, SMA distances/slope, Donchian and Stochastic position, ADX direction/strength, volatility regime and volume surprise); nearest neighbours by scaled Euclidean distance; candidate outcomes must end on or before the origin
indicator_analog_now.warning: Another conditional histogram of THIS sample, not a third independent oracle: indicators are transformations of the same price path and are often correlated. Believe only the blind ensemble rows beside it.

path_data.note: Path geometry is computed from completed closes (and real highs/lows/volume when present). On close-only bars the range-position pieces collapse to the close path; no candle anatomy or volume is invented.

path_analog_now.method: 16 origin-time path-geometry features per completed bar (20/60-bar travel efficiency, volatility-normalized log-trend slopes, 5-bar variance ratio, lag-1 autocorrelation, skew/downside share, 60-bar drawdown/run-up/range position, 20-bar max drawdown, volatility and range compression, sign streak and real up/down volume balance); nearest neighbours by scaled Euclidean distance; candidate outcomes must end on or before the origin
path_analog_now.warning: A fourth conditional histogram of THIS sample, not a fourth oracle: path geometry re-describes the same completed bars. Only the blind race and after-cost rows beside it say whether the description helped here.

cycle_data.note: Cycle/flow coordinates use completed OHLCV only. On close-only bars, range and flow pieces collapse toward close-path/neutral values; highs, lows, volume and order flow are never invented.

cycle_analog_now.method: 18 origin-time cycle/flow features (Aroon, Vortex, CMO, Fisher, RVI, Schaff, KST, Coppock, CMF/MFI, Force Index, rolling VWAP distance, Ulcer, SuperSmoother slope, permutation entropy, Signed Path Pressure, Entropy-Weighted Multiscale Trend and overnight/intraday volatility balance); nearest neighbours by scaled Euclidean distance; candidate outcomes must end on or before the origin
cycle_analog_now.warning: A fifth conditional histogram of the same completed bars, not five independent sources of information. Flow formulas here are OHLCV proxies, not exchange order flow.

rank_fusion_analog_now.method: For every admissible past candidate, average its distance rank across the return/candle/indicator/path/cycle-flow views; take the lowest mean-rank neighbours. Candidate outcomes must end on or before the origin.
rank_fusion_analog_now.warning: Rank fusion cannot create new information: all views are transformations of the same completed bars. The blind race and costs decide whether it helped.

multiscale_trend_now.method: Average of tanh(return/(10-bar volatility*sqrt(window))) over available 3/5/10/20/60/120-bar windows (at least four required). Origin-time only.
multiscale_trend_now.warning: A bounded trend descriptor, not a probability and not a trade instruction. Its worth is decided only by the hidden-future rows.

kalman_trend_now.method: Causal alpha-beta local-linear trend on log price (level gain 0.35, slope gain 0.08); score=tanh(100*slope per bar).
kalman_trend_now.warning: A local trend descriptor, not a probability or trade instruction.

hull_trend_now.method: Hull MA(20) price distance plus 3-bar Hull slope, ATR-normalized and tanh-bounded.
hull_trend_now.warning: A trend descriptor, not a probability or trade instruction.

omni_direct_now.method: Fixed weighted average of available bounded direct components; not fitted to this symbol.
omni_direct_now.warning: A consensus score, not a probability and not a trade instruction.

atlas_pressure_wave_now.method: 15-bar exponentially weighted candle close/body pressure scaled by ATR range and real relative volume, fused with 3/10-bar volatility-normalized momentum.
atlas_pressure_wave_now.warning: A bounded origin-time research score, not a probability or trade instruction.

atlas_regime_compass_now.method: ADX and permutation entropy smoothly choose between Hull/multiscale trend evidence and Bollinger/RSI range-reversion evidence.
atlas_regime_compass_now.warning: A bounded origin-time research score, not a probability or trade instruction.

atlas_phoenix_now.method: Family-balanced fusion (trend filters 25%, momentum 25%, structure 20%, flow 20%, Regime Compass 10%); each family is averaged before fusion.
atlas_phoenix_now.warning: A bounded origin-time research score, not a probability or trade instruction.

atlas_minute_pulse_now.method: EMA ribbon 25% + Pressure Wave 25% + rolling-VWAP trend side 15% + UTC opening-range state 15% + volume surge 10% + squeeze release 10%, entropy-damped.
atlas_minute_pulse_now.warning: A bounded origin-time research score, not a probability or trade instruction.

rolling_eval.regime_note: Buckets use only origin-time information (price vs causal SMA-20; 10-bar volatility vs its trailing-100-bar median). Small buckets are noise with labels — compare against always-up inside the same bucket.
honesty_notes: Out-of-sample by construction: analogs and their outcomes all predate each origin.
Origins may overlap in time, so attempts are not fully independent — treat the accuracy gap, not the third decimal, as the signal.
One symbol and one era prove nothing about other symbols, eras or the future; re-run per series and distrust any single-sample 'edge'.
Direction accuracy ignores magnitude, costs and risk: a 55% direction rate can still lose money after spreads, fees and tails.

indicator_data.note: On close-only bars, range-based indicators collapse to functions of the close path; they do not invent highs, lows or candle anatomy.

path_data.note: Path geometry is computed from completed closes (and real highs/lows/volume when present). On close-only bars the range-position pieces collapse to the close path; no candle anatomy or volume is invented.

cycle_data.note: Cycle/flow coordinates use completed OHLCV only. On close-only bars, range and flow pieces collapse toward close-path/neutral values; highs, lows, volume and order flow are never invented.

multiscale_trend.rule: sign of the average tanh(return/(10-bar volatility*sqrt(window))) across available windows

multiscale_confidence_coverage.warning: Coverage-limited diagnostic only. A high selective rate is not the full-test score, is never eligible for best_method_on_this_sample, and score magnitude may not calibrate across symbols/eras.

adaptive_selector.rule: Follow the candidate with the best shrunken hit rate over fully revealed prior attempts only: (revealed_hits + 5) / (revealed_attempts + 10). A prior attempt is revealed only when old_origin + horizon <= current origin, so overlapping unfinished windows cannot teach the selector early.
adaptive_selector.fallback: majority_vote_v8 when available, otherwise the newest available majority vote, then momentum_5bar

v11_direct_methods.kalman_trend: sign of causal alpha-beta log-price slope (level gain 0.35, slope gain 0.08)
v11_direct_methods.omni_direct_consensus: fixed weighted fusion of multiscale trend (1.2), Kalman slope (0.9), horizon-matched trend (0.7), Parabolic SAR (0.5) and a CCI/Williams/TSI/TRIX/Ultimate/CMO/Fisher/Schaff oscillator basket (0.5)
v11_direct_methods.rank_fusion_analog: neighbours selected by mean normalized distance rank across the five existing feature families

v12_direct_methods.hull_trend: Hull MA price distance plus 3-bar slope, ATR-normalized
v12_direct_methods.markov_regime: trend/volatility/RSI state; sign is mean fully revealed prior-attempt outcome in that state after 10 samples, otherwise multiscale
v12_direct_methods.atlas_fusion_v12: majority of Hull, Kalman, Markov regime, Omni and multiscale votes

v13_direct_methods.classic_and_modern: Aroon, TSI, TRIX, CMO, Ultimate, RVI, 20/60 log-regression, Donchian, OBV flow and Coppock are raced as bounded direct signs beside every older method.
v13_direct_methods.atlas_pressure_wave: 15-bar exponentially weighted candle close/body pressure scaled by ATR range and real relative volume, fused with 3/10-bar volatility-normalized momentum; close-only inputs collapse honestly to close-path pressure.
v13_direct_methods.atlas_regime_compass: ADX/permutation-entropy trend weight blends Hull/multiscale trend with Bollinger/RSI range reversion.
v13_direct_methods.atlas_phoenix_fusion: family-balanced fusion: trend filters 25%, momentum 25%, structure 20%, OHLCV flow proxies 20%, Regime Compass 10%; correlated inputs are averaged inside families first.
v13_direct_methods.majority_vote_v8: all available analog-family, v4-v12 direct and v13 direct votes; Phoenix/Pressure/Atlas Fusion breaks ties in that order.

atlas_meta_hedge.rule: Exponentially weighted majority over 16 diversified contestants. A revealed hit multiplies a candidate weight by exp(+0.15), a miss by exp(-0.15), then weights are renormalized to mean 1. Labels reveal only when old_origin + horizon <= current origin.

atlas_online_logistic.rule: Online logistic regression on bounded origin-time scores/analog shares. One L2-regularized SGD update (learning rate 0.08, lambda 0.002) is applied only after an attempt's full horizon has revealed; missing features are neutral zero, never future-filled.

v13_meta_learners.warning: Causal online learning prevents label leakage, not overfitting, regime change or correlated-input double counting. A meta-learner trained inside one race still needs untouched symbols/eras before anyone should trust it.

honesty_notes: Several variants raced on ONE sample: the best-looking one is inflated by multiple comparisons. Treat the winner as a hypothesis to re-test on fresh data, never as a discovered edge.
agreement_only accuracy is meaningless without its coverage: a filter that speaks rarely can look clever while avoiding most of the test.
Cost rows use overlapping origins, so totals are NOT a compounded equity curve — read mean-net-per-trade and win-rate-after-cost instead.
Costs shown are flat round-trip bps; real spreads/slippage vary by market, size and hour and are usually worse than the tidy number.

Candle-shape neighbours can be numerous and near-duplicates within one trend; their outcome spread is sample folklore until this same blind test survives a second symbol/era. Close-only bars are reported unavailable, not scored as zero.

Indicator-regime neighbours are transformations of the same historical price path, not independent information: RSI, MACD, Bollinger, Stochastic and Donchian can all agree because they are looking at one move through related windows. On close-only data the range-based pieces collapse to close-path functions and are labelled as such.
consensus_3plus is a coverage-limited subset, never a full-test score: judge it only beside its attempts/coverage and after-cost rows, and expect small subsets to wobble.

Path-geometry neighbours re-describe the same completed price path (efficiency, variance scaling, drawdowns and streaks are not new information arriving from outside the chart). On close-only data its high/low pieces collapse to closes and its volume balance is zero rather than invented.

adaptive_selector is causal by construction — it learns only from attempts whose outcome window had already ended — but it is still selecting among many correlated contestants on one sample. A good selector score here is a reason to re-test on a second symbol/era, not evidence of a durable forecasting edge.

Cycle/flow neighbours add classic Aroon/Vortex/Fisher/Schaff/KST/Coppock and OHLCV flow proxies, but they remain transformations of the same bars. CMF/MFI/Force/VWAP are not exchange order-flow data, and close-only inputs collapse toward neutral.

multiscale_trend is a direct trend contestant, not a nearest-neighbour oracle. A 60/100-style result beside momentum's high-50s on one sample is inside ordinary sampling noise unless it survives other horizons, symbols, eras and costs.
multiscale confidence rows are selective subsets. Their accuracy must always be read with attempts and coverage; TradeAtlas does not let a threshold manufacture a headline.

v11 adds Kalman, PSAR/Ichimoku/oscillator-informed direct fusion and rank-fused neighbours. They are more transformations of the same OHLCV bars, so a higher sample score can still be multiple-comparison luck; no universal percentage lift is claimed.
v12 adds Hull/Supertrend/Kaufman/Haar and a causal Markov-regime vote. More methods also means more chances to overfit one sample; an 80% universal direction rate is not claimed.

v13 adds Aroon/TSI/TRIX/CMO/Ultimate/RVI/regression/Donchian/OBV/Coppock direct signs, invented Pressure Wave/Regime Compass/Phoenix scores, and causal Meta Hedge + online logistic learners. They are still deterministic transformations or delayed-label fits to the same OHLCV history; more machinery can lose faster and an 80% universal rate remains unproven.

multiscale_trend_eval.method: fixed multiscale trend score; origins selected exactly like the ensemble race
multiscale_trend_eval.warning: Neighbouring horizons are a fragility check, not independent confirmations: overlapping windows on one symbol/era remain one sample.

direct_method_eval.method: fixed v11/v12/v13 direct scores; origins selected exactly like the ensemble race
direct_method_eval.warning: Neighbouring horizons and methods are correlated checks on one sample, not independent confirmations.

path_simulation.warning: Bootstrapped from the realized paths of similar past setups in THIS file. It quantifies how wide the historical spread was; it is not a probability distribution for the future and inherits every bias of the sample.

disclaimer: Educational/research output only — not financial advice and not a recommendation. Mechanical indicator conditions can be wrong, historical accuracy does not predict future results, and most short-term traders lose money. Verify data rights, costs, liquidity, taxes and broker rules independently; consider paper trading first.
